system.requirements: An animal within 15 feet can perceive you, and you have never attacked it.
system.effect:
Attempt an Animal Handling check against the animal’s Guard, with the following results, depending on how many actions you took:
❷ Quick Calm.
Critical Success Suppress 2 points of its Frightened value until the end of its next Opportunity.
Success Suppress 1 point of its Frightened value until the end of its next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure It avoids your approach, and you cannot try again this encounter.
❸ Deliberate Calm.
Critical Success Recall two useful facts.
Success Recall a useful fact.
Failure or Critical Failure Nothing happens.
Note: A Success or Critical Success also lets a non-hostile animal tolerate a simple contact, such as taking its reins. Threatening it ends that tolerance.
This does not end hostility or magical control.
